needles.title: Nonlocal Proliferation and Explosive Tumour Dynamics: Mechanistic Modelling and Bayesian Inference
needles.verdict: A genuinely new mechanism for explosive tumour growth, established with rigorous analytical proofs and absent from the existing literature.

needles.title: Optimal spatial release strategies for confined gene drives and Wolbachia
needles.verdict: A genuinely new framework for choosing where and when to release confined gene drives and Wolbachia, more complete than anything in the existing literature.

needles.title: Local equations for the generalized Lotka-Volterra model on sparse asymmetric graphs
needles.verdict: The first mapping of the phase diagram for sparse, asymmetric ecological networks, opening a regime the field had left unexplored.

needles.title: General predictions for the effects of warming on competition
needles.verdict: A genuinely new theory tying metabolic scaling to species coexistence, yielding general predictions for how warming reshapes competition that the existing literature lacks.

needles.title: Decoding species coexistence: A reinforcement learning perspective
needles.verdict: A genuinely new, learning-based way for organisms to adapt their mobility that resolves a long-standing coexistence puzzle left open in the existing literature.

needles.title: Modeling Epidemic Dynamics of Mutant Strains with Evolutionary Game-based Vaccination Behavior
needles.verdict: A genuinely new coupling of viral mutation with the way people change their vaccination choices, closing a gap the existing literature left open by treating behavior as fixed.

needles.title: Mechanistic-statistical inference of mosquito dynamics from mark-release-recapture data
needles.verdict: A genuinely new way to jointly infer mosquito movement, survival, and recapture from field data, a combined treatment not present in the existing literature.

needles.title: Equilibrium and Competition in Evolutionary Dynamics
needles.verdict: Rigorous new proofs that settle the long-term behavior of competing polymerization dynamics, a level of mathematical guarantee the existing literature had not reached.

needles.title: Inhomogeneous Branching Random Walks: Incorporating Genealogy and Density Effects
needles.verdict: A genuinely new way to build lineage history and crowding into branching random walks, a combination the existing literature had not addressed.
